Meet with managing project sponsor to understand the business context, goals and project rationale

Discuss the goals, objectives, opportunities/problems, and other strategic information with the project sponsor. Verify the currency and validity of the business goals, objectives, critical success factors, opportunities, and problems that the project is expected to address. Business goals, objectives, critical success factors, opportunities, and problems are part of the business strategy information of the enterprise. Review this information carefully. If the enterprise strategy has not been documented or is not available, you will need to identify the basic strategic direction of the project with the sponsor.
